# Stomach contents

```{r stomach content cleanup, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

### Magenzusammensetzung

stomach <- fread("Data/Pike/SC_Database.csv")

stomach$Date <- gsub("\\.", "-", stomach$Date)

stomach2 <- stomach%>%
  transmute(Date = lubridate::parse_date_time(Date, orders = c("dmy")),
            Fish_ID = Fish_ID,
            Species = case_when(Species == "S. lucioperca" ~ "Sander lucioperca",
                                Species == "P.fluviatilis" ~ "Perca fluviatilis",
                                Species == "S.erythrophthalmus" ~ "Scardinius erythrophthalmus",
                                Species == "C.harengus" ~ "Clupea harengus",
                                Species == "G.aculeatus" ~ "Gasteroseus aculeatus",
                                Species == "P.pungitius" ~ "Pungitius pungitius",
                                Species == "I.alpestris" ~ "I.alpestris",
                                Species == "Gastropoda" ~ "Gastropoda",
                                Species == "R.rutilus" ~ "Rutilus rutilus",
                                Species == "N.melanostomus" ~ "Neogobius melanostomus",
                                Species == "Isopoda" ~ "Isopoda",
                                Species == "A.aquaticus" ~ "A.aquaticus",
                                Species == "Gammarus" ~ "Gammarus",
                                Species == "E.danica" ~ "Sander lucioperca",
                                Species == "S.spinachia" ~ "Spinachia spinachia",
                                Species == "P.flesus" ~ "Platichthys flesus",
                                Species == "P.elegans" ~ "P.elegans",
                                Species == "fish larva" ~ "fish larva",
                                Species == "A.brama" ~ "Abramis brama",
                                Species == "B.bjoerkna" ~ "Blicca bjoerkna",
                                Species == "A.alburnus" ~ "Alburnus alburnus",
                                Species == "G.cernua" ~ "Gymnocephalus cernua"),
            sex = sex,
            pike_weight_g = Weight_g,
            pike_TL_mm = Total_Length_mm,
            length = prey_length_mm,
            weight = Prey_weight_g,
            stomach_weight = Stomach_weight_g,
            area = Area,
            gear = Gear)

Pike <- fread("C:/Users/timor/Nextcloud2/Boddenhecht/Data/Pike Data/1.pike_data_base_FOR_USERS/1Pike_Latest_Version.txt")
SI <- fread("C:/Users/timor/Nextcloud2/Boddenhecht/Data/Pike Data/1.pike_data_base_FOR_USERS/1Sampling_Instance_Latest_Version.txt")

nordic <- fread("Data/Prey/Nordic multimesh gillnets.csv")
names(nordic)[7] <- c("length")
names(nordic)[8] <- c("weight")

# binding data frames
nordic <- plyr::rbind.fill(stomach2,nordic)
str(nordic)
unique(nordic$Species)
nordic$Species <- as.factor(as.character(nordic$Species))
nordic$weight <- as.numeric(as.character(nordic$weight))
nordic$length <- as.numeric(as.character(nordic$length))

#####Rename Species because written wrong
levels(nordic$Species)[levels(nordic$Species)=="Perca fluviatilis "] <- "Perca fluviatilis"
levels(nordic$Species)[levels(nordic$Species)=="Rutilus rutilus "] <- "Rutilus rutilus"
levels(nordic$Species)[levels(nordic$Species)=="Pungitius pungitius"] <- "Pungitis pungitis"
levels(nordic$Species)[levels(nordic$Species)=="Neogobius melanostomus "] <- "Neogobius melanostomus"
levels(nordic$Species)[levels(nordic$Species)=="Spinachia spinachia"] <- "Spinachio spinachio"

#calculate missing lengths and weights
for(i in 1:nrow(nordic)){
  row.i <- nordic[i,]
  if(is.na(row.i$length)){
    mod <- mean(filter(nordic, Species == row.i$Species)$length,na.rm=TRUE)
    # Now assign calculated value into cell of original dataframe
    nordic[i,]$length <- mod
    cat(i, "done ", row.i$Species,"\n")
  }else{cat(".")}
}

nordic <- nordic%>%filter(length != "NaN")

for(i in 1:nrow(nordic)){
  row.i <- nordic[i,]
  if(is.na(row.i$weight)){
    mod <- lm(data = filter(nordic, Species == row.i$Species), log(weight) ~ log(length))
    log.weight <- predict(mod, data.frame(length = row.i$length))
    pred.weight <- 2.718281828459 ^ log.weight
    # Now assign calculated value into cell of original dataframe
    nordic[i,]$weight <- pred.weight
    cat(i, "done ", row.i$Species,"\n")
  }else{cat(".")}
}

Pike_SC <- nordic%>%filter(!is.na(Fish_ID))%>%
  transmute(Date = Date,
            fish_ID = Fish_ID,
            species = Species,
            sex = sex,
            pike_weight_g = pike_weight_g,
            pike_TL_mm = pike_TL_mm,
            prey_length_mm = length,
            prey_weight_g = weight,
            area = area)

fwrite(Pike_SC, "Data/Pike/Stomach-contents-Database-clean.csv")

Marlon_SC <- fread("Data/Pike/SC_Marlon-MA.csv")

Marlon_SC2 <- Marlon_SC%>%
  transmute(Date = Date.x,
            fish_ID = Fish_ID,
            species = Species,
            sex = NA,
            pike_weight_g = Weight,
            pike_TL_mm = Total_Length_mm,
            prey_length_mm = length,
            prey_weight_g = weight,
            area = case_when(Comparison_Area_Name == "Werderbucht" ~ "BAT",
                             Comparison_Area_Name == "Ummanz" ~ "SB",
                             Comparison_Area_Name == "Neuensiener_Selliner_See" ~ "GB"))

SC_all <- rbind(Pike_SC, Marlon_SC2)

fwrite(SC_all, "Data/Pike/Stomach-contents-all-clean.csv")
```

```{r stomach contents graphics, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

SC_data <- fread("Data/Pike/Stomach-contents-all-clean.csv")

SC_data2 <- SC_data%>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(lubridate::parse_date_time(Date, "d.m.y")),
         area2 = as.factor(case_when(area == "GB" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "SB" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "Duwenbeek" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "NHG" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "Ziese" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "Sehrowbach" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "Barthe" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "KB" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "P" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "BAT" ~ "lagoon")))

#Join with energy density data
Prey <- fread("Data/Prey/Preyfish_samples.CSV")

Prey_energy <- fread("Data/Prey/Preyfish_energy_content.csv")
Prey_energy2 <- Prey_energy%>%
  group_by(ID)%>%
  reframe(Number = ID,
          Caloric_value_mJ_per_kg = mean(Caloric_value_mJ_per_kg))%>%
  distinct()

Prey_energy_species2 <- Prey_energy2%>%
  left_join(Prey, by = "Number")%>%
  mutate(species = case_when(Species == "Flounder" ~ "Platichthys flesus",
                             Species == "G. aculeatus" ~ "other",
                             Species == "Herring" ~ "Clupea harengus",
                             Species == "N. melanostomus" ~ "Neogobius melanostomus",
                             Species == "P. flesus" ~ "Platichthys flesus",
                             Species == "P. fluviatilis" ~ "Perca fluviatilis",
                             Species == "Perch" ~ "Perca fluviatilis",
                             Species == "R.rutilus" ~ "Rutilus rutilus",
                             Species == "Roach" ~ "Rutilus rutilus",
                             Species == "Three-spined stickleback" ~ "other",
                             Species == "White bream" ~ "other",
                             ID == "BF-624" ~ "Clupea harengus",
                             ID == "BF-625" ~ "Clupea harengus",
                             ID == "BF-626" ~ "Clupea harengus",
                             ID == "BF-627" ~ "Clupea harengus"),
         order = case_when(species == "Clupea harengus" ~ 1,
                            species == "Rutilus rutilus" ~ 2,
                            species == "Perca fluviatilis" ~ 3,
                            species == "Neogobius melanostomus" ~ 4,
                            species == "Platichthys flesus" ~ 5,
                            species == "other" ~ 6))%>%
  distinct()

Prey_energy_species2$species <- reorder(Prey_energy_species2$species, Prey_energy_species2$order)

Spec_energy <- Prey_energy_species2%>%
  group_by(species)%>%
  reframe(species = species,
          spec_energy_cont = mean(Caloric_value_mJ_per_kg))%>%
  distinct()

A1 <- aov(Caloric_value_mJ_per_kg~as.factor(species), data = Prey_energy_species2)
summary(A1)
pairwise.t.test(Prey_energy_species2$Caloric_value_mJ_per_kg, as.factor(Prey_energy_species2$species), p.adj = "bonf")


SC_summary <- SC_data2%>%
  reframe(species = case_when(species == "Gasteroseus aculeatus" ~ "Gasterosteus aculeatus",
                              species == "Gammerus sp." ~ "Gammarus",
                              species == "P.elegans" ~ "Palaemon adspersus",
                              species == "Pungitis pungitis" ~ "Pungitius pungitius",
                              species == "Spinachio spinachio" ~ "Spinachia spinachia",
                              TRUE ~ species),
          prey_weight_g = prey_weight_g,
          total_biomass_g = sum(prey_weight_g, na.rm = T),
          area2 = area2)%>%
  left_join(Prey_energy_species2, by = "species")%>%
  group_by(species)%>%
  reframe(species = as.factor(species),
          prey_weight_g = sum(prey_weight_g, na.rm = T),
          total_biomass_g = total_biomass_g,
          spec_energy_cont = case_when(is.na(Species) == FALSE ~ Caloric_value_mJ_per_kg/1000*prey_weight_g,
                                       TRUE ~ 18.79740/1000*prey_weight_g),
          area2 = area2)%>%
  mutate(proportion = prey_weight_g/total_biomass_g)%>%
  distinct()

SC_summary2 <- SC_summary%>%
  reframe(species = case_when(proportion < 0.05 ~ "other",
                              TRUE ~ species),
          proportion = proportion,
          spec_energy_cont = spec_energy_cont,
          area2 = area2)%>%
  group_by(species, area2)%>%
  reframe(proportion2 = sum(proportion),
          spec_energy_mJ = sum(spec_energy_cont),
          order = case_when(species == "Clupea harengus" ~ 1,
                            species == "Rutilus rutilus" ~ 2,
                            species == "Perca fluviatilis" ~ 3,
                            species == "Neogobius melanostomus" ~ 4,
                            species == "Platichthys flesus" ~ 5,
                            species == "other" ~ 6))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  distinct()%>%
  mutate(total_energy = sum(spec_energy_mJ),
         prop_energy = spec_energy_mJ/total_energy)


SC_summary2$species <- reorder(SC_summary2$species, SC_summary2$order)

Props <- ggplot(SC_summary2, aes(x = "", y = proportion2, fill = species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +  # Convert to a polar coordinate for pie chart
  labs(title = "proportion of biomass",
       fill = "Species") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(proportion2)), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5))+
  scale_fill_viridis_d(alpha = 0.9)+
  theme_void()

Energ <- ggplot(Prey_energy_species2, aes(x = species, y = Caloric_value_mJ_per_kg, fill = species))+
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8)+
  labs(title = "Specific energy content",
       y = "Caloric value (mJ/kg)",
       fill = "Species")+
  scale_fill_viridis_d()+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(88,1,1,1))

Pies <- ggarrange(Props, Energ, common.legend = T, labels = c("A", "B"))

ggsave("Figures/Stomach-contents-all.png", Pies, width = 15, height = 15, units = "cm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r pike muscle data cleanup, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

#read in pike data from source
Pike1 <- read.delim("C:/Users/timor/Nextcloud2/Boddenhecht/Data/Pike Data/1.pike_data_base_FOR_USERS/1Pike_Latest_Version.txt", 
                    sep = ";", dec = ".", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

Pike2 <- Pike1%>%
  filter(MarkorRecap=="Mark")%>%
  transmute(ID=case_when(Fish_ID=="BH-91050.2"~"BH-91050",
                         Fish_ID=="BH-51614"&Waterbody=="BAT"~"NA",
                         Fish_ID=="BH-90307"&MarkorRecap=="Mark"~"NA",
                         TRUE~Fish_ID),
            capt_date=Date,
            TL_mm = Total_Length_mm,
            weight=Weight,
            sex=Sex,
            area=Waterbody,
            Long=case_when(is.na(Capture_Longitude)==T~Release_Longitude,
                           TRUE~Capture_Longitude),
            Lat=case_when(is.na(Capture_Latitude)==T~Release_Latitude,
                          TRUE~Capture_Latitude))

#Read pike SI data
pike_NCS1 <- read.csv2("Data/Pike/2022-09-08_NCS_Pike.CSV", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

pike_NCS2 <- pike_NCS1%>%
  transmute(ID=substr(Identifier.1, 1,8),
            ID2=substr(Identifier.1,9,10),
            Sample="Muscle",
            d15N=as.numeric(d.15N.14N.Calculated),
            d13C=as.numeric(d.13C.12C.Calculated),
            d34S=as.numeric(d.34S.32S.Calculated),
            CN_ratio=as.numeric(C..)/as.numeric(N..),
            comment=paste(Comment.1,"|",Comment.2))%>%
  filter(!grepl("Measurement repeated", comment)|ID=="BH-00380"|ID=="BH-00829")

Mixed <- read.delim("Data/Pike/2021-02 Boddenhecht Timo Rittweg TG.txt")

Mixed2 <- Mixed%>%
  transmute(ID=ID2,
            ID2=NA,
            Sample=ID1,
            d15N=as.numeric(d15N..permil.N2.atm.),
            d13C=as.numeric(d13C..permil.VPDB.),
            d34S=as.numeric(d34S..permil.CDT.),
            CN_ratio=as.numeric(weight.C)/as.numeric(weight.N),
            comment=NA)%>%
  filter(Sample!="Eyelens")

pike_NCS2 <- rbind(pike_NCS2, Mixed2)

pike_NCS3 <- fread("Data/Pike/2023-04-21_NCS_Pike.CSV")

pike_NCS4 <- pike_NCS3%>%
  transmute(ID=Identifier.1,
            ID2=NA,
            Sample=Identifier.2,
            d15N=as.numeric(d15N),
            d13C=as.numeric(d13C),
            d34S=as.numeric(d34S),
            CN_ratio=(Amount.ug*(Cperc/100))/(Amount.ug*(Nperc/100)),
            comment=Comment)%>%
  filter(Sample!="eye lens")

pike_NCSall <- rbind(pike_NCS2, pike_NCS4)

#check A & B samples against each other
PikeA <- subset(pike_NCSall, ID2 == "A")
PikeB <- subset(pike_NCSall, ID2 == "B")
PikeAB <- rbind(PikeA, PikeB)

anova <- PikeAB%>%

N <- ggplot(PikeAB)+

ggarrange(N,C,S)

#Join pike data
length(unique(pike_NCSall$ID))

Pikedata <- Pike2%>%

length(unique(Pikedata$ID))

#check missing fish
pikeSIall <- data.frame(ID = unique(pike_NCSall$ID))
pikeSIDall <- data.frame(ID = unique(Pikedata$ID), Sample = "TRUE")

Pikecheck <- pikeSIall%>%
  left_join(pikeSIDall, by = "ID")


#average SI values
pikedata2 <- Pikedata%>%
  group_by(ID)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(ID=ID,
            ID2=ID2,
            capt_date=capt_date,
            TL_mm=TL_mm,
            weight_g=weight,
            sex=sex,
            area=area,
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,

#Join ecotype pike with SI data
Otopike <- read.delim("Data/Pike/Pikedata_ecotypes.txt", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = "\t", dec = ".")

Otopike.SI <- Otopike%>%left_join(pikedata2, by="ID")%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            ID2=ID2,
            capt_date=capt_date,
            TL_mm=TL_mm.x,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            sex=sex.x,
            study_area=waterbody,
            waterbody=area,
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,
            lifeyear=lifeyear,
            inc_um=inc_um,
            res_mean=res_mean,
            Sr_mean=Sr_mean,
            SI_sample=Sample_type,
            ecotype=ecotype,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13C,
            d34S=d34S,
            CN_ratio=CN_ratio,
            comment=comment)

length(unique(Otopike.SI[is.na(Otopike.SI$d13C)==F,]$ID))
length(unique(Otopike.SI$ID))

#Lipid correction

ggplot(data=pikedata2, aes(x=CN_ratio, y=d13C))+
  geom_smooth(method="lm")+geom_point()+
  theme_bw()

dep <-  pikedata2
dep$rcn <- with(dep, CN_ratio)
dep$L <- with(dep,-20.54+7.24*rcn)
 
mean(dep$d13C, na.rm = T);sd(dep$d13C, na.rm = T)
mean(dep$rcn);sd(dep$rcn)

# Fishes Kiljunen et al.(2006) # Carefull, this correction is not adequate for invertebrates!!!
dep$d13Cc<-with(dep,ifelse(rcn>3.5, d13C+7.018*(0.048+3.9/(1+287/L)),d13C))

dep2 <- dep%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            ID2=ID2,
            Species="E.lucius",
            capt_date=capt_date,
            TL_mm=TL_mm,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            sex=sex,
            sample_type=Sample_type,
            area=area,
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13Cc,
            d34S=d34S,
            CN_ratio=CN_ratio,
            comment=comment)

fwrite(dep2, "Data/Pike/Pike_SI_all_clean_average_lipid-corrected.csv")
fwrite(pikedata2, "Data/Pike/Pike_SI_all_clean_average.csv")
fwrite(Otopike.SI, "Data/Pike/Otopike_SI_clean_average.csv")
```

```{r pike ecotypes cleanup, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

Allpike <- fread("Data/Pike/Pike_SI_all_clean_average_lipid-corrected.csv")
Otopike <- fread("Data/Pike/Otopike_SI_clean_average.csv")
Telepike <- fread("Data/Pike/Pikedata_telemetry_types.txt")

Save_anadrom_tele <- Telepike%>%
  group_by(ID)%>%
  mutate(score = case_when(diag == "Anadrom" ~ 10,
                           diag == "Brackish" ~ 100,
                           diag == "Fresh" ~ 200,
                           diag == "Ubergangs I" ~ 300,
                           diag == "Ubergangs II" ~ 400,
                           diag == "nodata"~1,
                           TRUE ~ 0))%>%
    reframe(ID = ID,
            scoresum = sum(score),
            diag)%>%
    filter(scoresum > 10 & scoresum < 100)%>%
  transmute(ID, 
            ecotype = "Anadromous")%>%
  distinct()

Save_anadrom_oto <- Otopike%>%
  filter(ecotype == "Anadromous")%>%
  transmute(ID,
            ecotype)%>%
  distinct()

Save_anadrom <- rbind(Save_anadrom_oto, Save_anadrom_tele)

PikeDB <- fread("C:/Users/timor/Nextcloud2/Boddenhecht/Data/Pike Data/1.pike_data_base_FOR_USERS/1Pike_Latest_Version.txt")

Pike_geno <- fread("Data/Pike/Ecotypes/discrete-cluster-assignment.csv")

PikeDB$waterbody <- PikeDB$Waterbody
PikeDB$ID <- PikeDB$Fish_ID

Save_anadrom_loc <- Save_anadrom%>%
  inner_join(PikeDB, by = "ID")%>%
  transmute(ID, ecotype, waterbody)%>%
  distinct()

Save_anadrom_loc_geno <- Save_anadrom_loc%>%
  left_join(Pike_geno, by = "ID")%>%
  transmute(ID, ecotype, 
            genotype = case_when(hardclust == "1" ~ "freshwater genotype",
                                 hardclust == "2" ~ "brackish genotype",
                                 hardclust == "3" ~ "anadromous genotype",
                                 hardclust == "U" ~ "unassigned genotype"),
            waterbody=waterbody.x)

fwrite(Save_anadrom_loc_geno, "Data/Pike/Ecotypes/certain-anadromous.csv")

#Reformat Otopike
Otopike2 <- Otopike%>%
  transmute(ID = ID,
            capt_date = capt_date,
            TL_mm = TL_mm,
            weight_g = weight_g,
            sex = sex,
            area = study_area,
            Long = Long,
            Lat = Lat,
            ecotype = case_when(ecotype == "FW_resident" ~ "FW-resident",
                                ecotype == "Trans-habitat" ~ "Cross-habitat",
                                TRUE ~ ecotype),
            d15N = d15N,
            d13C = d13C,
            d34S = d34S,
            CN_ratio = CN_ratio)%>%
  drop_na(d34S)%>%
  distinct()

#Reformat telepike
Telepike2 <- Telepike%>%
  filter(diag != "nodata")%>%
  transmute(ID = ID,
            ecotype = diag,
            area = Area)%>%
  distinct()
  
#Join
TeleSI <- Allpike%>%
  inner_join(Telepike2, by = "ID")%>%
  transmute(ID = ID,
            capt_date = capt_date,
            TL_mm = TL_mm,
            weight_g = weight_g,
            sex = sex,
            area = case_when(area.x == "Peene" ~ "Tributary",
                             area.x == "U" ~ "NA",
                             area.x == "Sehrowbach" ~ "Tributary",
                             area.x == "Barthe" ~ "Tributary",
                             area.x == "Beek" ~ "Tributary",
                             area.x == "Duwenbeek" ~ "Tributary",
                             area.x == "NHG" ~ "Tributary",
                             area.x == "Ziese" ~ "Tributary",
                             TRUE ~ area.x),
            Long = Long,
            Lat = Lat,
            ecotype = case_when(ecotype == "Brackish" ~ "BW-resident",
                                ecotype == "Fresh" ~ "FW-resident",
                                ecotype == "Ubergangs II" ~ "Cross-habitat",
                                ecotype == "Ubergangs I" ~ "Cross-habitat",
                                ecotype == "Anadrom" ~ "Anadromous"),
            d15N = d15N,
            d13C = d13C,
            d34S = d34S,
            CN_ratio = CN_ratio)%>%
  distinct()

#Ecotypes
Ecotypes_SI <- rbind(Otopike2, TeleSI)

fwrite(Ecotypes_SI, "Data/Pike/Ecotypes-Oto-Tele_SI_clean.csv")
```

```{r Prey lipid correction, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
Prey <- fread("Data/Prey/Preyfish_SI_clean_average.csv")

#Calculate mean of N and C for each species
m_by_sp<-aggregate(cbind(d15N, d13C, d34S)~Species, data=Prey, FUN=mean)
# Now the standard deviation
sd_by_sp<-aggregate(cbind(d15N, d13C, d34S)~Species, data=Prey, FUN=sd)
# Merging df
descriptive<-cbind(m_by_sp, sd_by_sp)
descriptive<-descriptive[-5]
colnames(descriptive)<-c("Sp", "d15N", "d13C", "d34S", "sdd15N", "sdd13C", "sdd34S")
descriptive

## Now lets look at the range and n
range_by_sp<-aggregate(cbind(d15N, d13C, d34S)~Species, data=Prey, FUN=range)
range_by_sp
# N (How many observations)
length_by_sp<-aggregate(cbind(d15N, d13C, d34S)~Species, data=Prey, FUN=length)
length_by_sp

##### Using tydivers
data_res<-ddply(Prey, c("Species"), summarize, 
                count=length(Species),
                mC=mean(d13C), sdC=sd(d13C),
                mN=mean(d15N), sdN=sd(d15N),
                mS=mean(d34S), sdS=sd(d34S))
data_res
#####----- 4.0 Lets take a look at the data #####
# Carbon
ggplot(data=Prey, aes(x=Species, y=d13C, group=Species, colour=Species))+geom_boxplot()+geom_point(position="jitter")+
  theme_bw()
# Nitrogen
ggplot(data=Prey, aes(x=Species, y=d15N, group=Species, colour=Species))+geom_boxplot()+geom_point(position="jitter")+
  theme_bw()
#Sulphur
ggplot(data=Prey, aes(x=Species, y=d34S, group=Species, colour=Species))+geom_boxplot()+geom_point(position="jitter")+
  theme_bw()

### Lets plot d13C, d15N and CN 
melt_data<-melt(Prey, id.vars=c(1:11, 16,17))

### With this plot we can observe both isotopes in one plot and we can observe the difference between both of them
ggplot(data=melt_data, aes(x=Species, y=value, group=Species, colour=Species))+
  geom_boxplot()+geom_point(position="jitter")+facet_grid(variable~., scales="free_y")+
  theme_bw()


### Lets explore our fish data in more detail to see if we have a problem with the lipids
### First we subset the fish
ggplot(data=Prey[Prey$Species=="C.harengus"|Prey$Species=="P.fluviatilis"|Prey$Species=="R.rutilus"|
                   Prey$Species=="P.flesus"|Prey$Species=="N.melanostomus",], aes(x=CN_ratio, y=d13C))+
  geom_smooth(method="lm")+geom_point()+
  facet_grid(Species~., scales="free_y")+
  theme_bw()

#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
##### 5.0  Lipid correction for d13C depending on the C:N,  for values >3.5 (as recommended by Skinner et al 2016) #####
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Lipids are depleted in d13C relative to protein (muscle). 
#It can bias our interpretation of their position in the food web or get wrong proportion on mixing models
# For Anchovy
dep = subset(Prey, Species%in%c("C.harengus", "P.flesus","P.fluviatilis","R.rutilus","N.melanostomus"))
dep$rcn=with(dep, CN_ratio)
dep$L<-with(dep,-20.54+7.24*rcn)
 
mean(dep$d13C);sd(dep$d13C)
mean(dep$rcn);sd(dep$rcn)

# Fishes Kiljunen et al.(2006) # Carefull, this correction is not adequate for invertebrates!!!
dep$d13Cc<-with(dep,ifelse(rcn>3.5, d13C+7.018*(0.048+3.9/(1+287/L)),d13C))

depdep2 <- dep%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            Species=Species,
            capt_date=capt_date,
            SL_mm=SL_mm,
            SL_size_class=SL_size_class,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            height_mm=height_mm,
            sample_type=sample_type,
            area=area,
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13Cc,
            d34S=d34S,
            CN_ratio=CN_ratio,
            comment1=comment1,
            comment2=comment2)

C.corrected <- rbind(Prey[!Species%in%c("C.harengus", "P.flesus","P.fluviatilis","R.rutilus","N.melanostomus"),],depdep2)

fwrite(C.corrected, "Data/Prey/Preyfish_SI_clean_average_lipid-corrected.csv")
```

# Mixing models
```{r mixing models pike capture location, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
Prey <- fread("Data/Prey/Preyfish_SI_clean_average_lipid-corrected.csv")
Pike <- fread("Data/Pike/Pike_SI_all_clean_average_lipid-corrected.csv")

Prey$SL_mm <- as.numeric(Prey$SL_mm)

Prey1 <- Prey%>%filter(area != "Barthe" & area != "Ziese")%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            Species=Species,
            group=case_when(Species=="R.rutilus"~"freshwater benthivores",
                            Species=="C.harengus"~"C.harengus",
                            Species=="P.flesus"~"marine benthivores",
                            Species=="P.fluviatilis"~"freshwater benthivores",
                            Species=="N.melanostomus"~"N.melanostomus",
                            TRUE~"Other"),
            SL_mm=SL_mm,
            SL_size_class=SL_size_class,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            height_mm=height_mm,
            sample_type=sample_type,
            area=area,
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13C,
            d34S=d34S,
            CN_ratio=CN_ratio,
            comment1=comment1,
            comment2=comment2)%>%
  filter(group!="Other")

Pike2 <- Pike%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            Species="E.lucius",
            capt_date=as.character(capt_date),
            Length=TL_mm,
            SL_size_class=NA,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            height_mm=NA,
            sample_type="muscle",
            area=case_when(area=="Barthe"~"Zufluss",
                           area=="Barthe/Peene"~"Zufluss",
                           area=="BAT"~"Grabow",
                           area=="Beek"~"Zufluss",
                           area=="BEG"~"NRB",
                           area=="BEZ"~"NRB",
                           area=="Duwenbeek"~"Zufluss",
                           area=="GB"~"GB",
                           area=="GJB"~"NRB",
                           area=="KB"~"WRB",
                           area=="KD"~"KD",
                           area=="KJB"~"KJB",
                           area=="NHG"~"Zufluss",
                           area=="P"~"P",
                           area=="Peene"~"Zufluss",
                           area=="S"~"S",
                           area=="SB"~"WRB",
                           area=="Sehrowbach"~"Zufluss",
                           area=="U"~"U",
                           area=="VB"~"WRB",
                           area=="WB"~"NRB",
                           area=="Ziese"~"Zufluss"),
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13C,
            d34S=d34S,
            CN_ratio=CN_ratio,
            comment1=comment,
            comment2=NA)%>%
  mutate(halflife = exp(0.22*log(weight_g)+3.28))%>%
  filter(area!="KD"&area!="U")%>%
  drop_na(d15N,d13C,d34S,Length,area)%>%
  distinct()

fwrite(Pike2, "Data/Mixing models/Pikemix.csv")

mix.filename <- "Data/Mixing models/Pikemix.csv"

Pike3 <- Pike2%>%
  group_by(area)%>%
  reframe(area=area,
                   N = length(unique(ID)),
                   years = paste(min(year(parse_date_time(capt_date,"ymd")), na.rm = T), "-", max(year(parse_date_time(capt_date,"ymd")), na.rm = T)))%>%
  distinct()

# Load mixture data
mix <- load_mix_data(filename=mix.filename, 
                     iso_names=c("d15N", "d13C", "d34S"),
                     factors="area",
                     fac_random=FALSE,
                     fac_nested=FALSE,
                     cont_effects="Length")

# Prepare source data
m_by_sp<-aggregate(cbind(d15N, d13C, d34S)~group, data=Prey1, FUN=mean)

sd_by_sp<-aggregate(cbind(d15N, d13C, d34S)~group, data=Prey1, FUN=sd)

length_by_sp<-aggregate(cbind(d15N)~group, data=Prey1, FUN=length)


descriptive<-cbind(m_by_sp, sd_by_sp, length_by_sp)
descriptive<-descriptive[c(-5,-9)]
colnames(descriptive)<-c("prey", "Meand15N", "Meand13C", "Meand34S", "SDd15N", "SDd13C", "SDd34S","n")
fwrite(descriptive, "Data/Mixing models/Sources.csv")

source.filename <- "Data/Mixing models/Sources.csv"
# # Load source data
source<- load_source_data(filename=source.filename, source_factors=NULL,
                          conc_dep=FALSE, data_type="means", mix)

discr <- descriptive%>%
  transmute(prey=prey,
            Meand15N=3.3,
            Meand13C=1.3,
            Meand34S=0.5,
            SDd15N=0.26,
            SDd13C=0.3,
            SDd34S=0.56)

fwrite(discr, "Data/Mixing models/Discrimination.csv")

discr.filename <- "Data/Mixing models/Discrimination.csv"

discr.df <- load_discr_data(filename=discr.filename, mix)

plot_data(filename="isospace_plotn",
          plot_save_pdf=FALSE,
          plot_save_png=FALSE,
          return_obj = T,
          mix,source,discr.df)

##### 3. Writing the mode ######
# Name of the model
model_filename <- "Data/Mixing models/MixSIAR_model_pike.txt"

# Include residual error; appropriate in situations where, for instance, each mixture data point was 
# generated through the combination of many samples from the source population
resid_err <- TRUE

# Include process error; derived from an assumption about the mixing process. 
# Analyst provides a single mixture value for each of the j tracers considered
process_err <- TRUE

# Save it
write_JAGS_model(model_filename, resid_err, process_err, mix, source)

# We run a model with uninformative priors
jags.pike <- run_model(run="normal", mix, source, discr.df, model_filename, alpha.prior = 1)

# Extracting data
Pike_no_priors<-data.frame(jags.pike[["BUGSoutput"]][["sims.list"]][["p.global"]]) # p. global is the overall contribution by each species
# Extract column names
colnames(Pike_no_priors)<- source[["source_names"]]

write.csv(Pike_no_priors,paste("1. Pike (",Sys.Date(),")-fit.csv",sep=""),row.names = F)

saveRDS(jags.pike, "Data/Mixing models/Mixing.model-run-locations.rds")

# Obtain the WAIC for model comparison
WAIC_ice<-loo::loo(jags.pike$BUGSoutput$sims.list$loglik)
```

```{r mixing models ecotypes, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
model1_filename <- "Data/Mixing models/MixSIAR_model_pike-ecotype-TL.txt"
model2_filename <- "Data/Mixing models/MixSIAR_model_pike-TL.txt"
model3_filename <- "Data/Mixing models/MixSIAR_model_pike-ecotype.txt"
model4_filename <- "Data/Mixing models/MixSIAR_model_pike-area-TL.txt"

# Include residual error; appropriate in situations where, for instance, each mixture data point was 
# generated through the combination of many samples from the source population
resid_err <- TRUE

# Include process error; derived from an assumption about the mixing process. 
# Analyst provides a single mixture value for each of the j tracers considered
process_err <- TRUE

# Save it
write_JAGS_model(model0_filename, resid_err, process_err, mix0, source)
write_JAGS_model(model1_filename, resid_err, process_err, mix1, source)
write_JAGS_model(model2_filename, resid_err, process_err, mix2, source)
write_JAGS_model(model3_filename, resid_err, process_err, mix3, source)
write_JAGS_model(model4_filename, resid_err, process_err, mix4, source)

# We run a model with uninformative priors

jags.pike.4 <- run_model(run="test", mix4, source, discr.df, model4_filename, alpha.prior = 1)

saveRDS(jags.pike.0, "Data/Mixing models/Output/Mixing.model-normal-run-NULL.rds")
saveRDS(jags.pike.1, "Data/Mixing models/Output/Mixing.model-normal-run-ecotype_TL.rds")
saveRDS(jags.pike.2, "Data/Mixing models/Output/Mixing.model-normal-run-TL.rds")
```

```{r graphic mixing models overview simple, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
# Create diagnostics, summary statistics, and posterior plots
jags.pike <- readRDS("Data/Mixing models/Output/Mixing.model-test-run-ecotype_TL.rds")

                     iso_names=c("d15N", "d13C", "d34S"),
                     factors="ecotype",
                     fac_random=FALSE,
                     fac_nested=FALSE,
                     cont_effects="Length")

# Load source data
source<- load_source_data(filename=source.filename, source_factors=NULL,
                          conc_dep=FALSE, data_type="means", mix)

global.contrib.p <- data.frame(median = jags.pike$BUGSoutput$median$p.fac1, ecotype=c("anadromous",
                                                                                      "brackish resident",
                                                                                      "cross-habitat",
                                                                                      "freshwater resident"))
global.contrib.sd <- data.frame(sd = jags.pike$BUGSoutput$sd$p.fac1,
                                ecotype=c("anadromous",
                                          "brackish resident",
                                          "cross-habitat",
                                          "freshwater resident"))

names(global.contrib.p) <- c(paste0("p.", source[["source_names"]]),"ecotype")
names(global.contrib.sd) <- c(paste0("sd.", source[["source_names"]]),"ecotype")

sum <- rowSums(global.contrib.p[,1:3])

global.contrib.p2 <- global.contrib.p%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = p.freshwater:p.marine,names_to = "species", values_to = "median")%>%
  transmute(ecotype=fct_relevel(ecotype,
                                "freshwater resident",
                                "anadromous",
                                "cross-habitat",
                                "brackish resident"),
            species=sub("p.","",species),
            median=median)
global.contrib.sd2 <- global.contrib.sd%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = sd.freshwater:sd.marine,names_to = "species", values_to = "sd")%>%
  transmute(ecotype=fct_relevel(ecotype,
                                "freshwater resident",
                                "anadromous",
                                "cross-habitat",
                                "brackish resident"),
            species=sub("sd.","",species),
            sd=sd)

global.contrib2 <- global.contrib.p2%>%inner_join(global.contrib.sd2, by = c("species", "ecotype"))


indiv.contrib <- data.frame(contr=jags.pike$BUGSoutput$mean$p.ind)
indiv.sd <- data.frame(sd=jags.pike$BUGSoutput$sd$p.ind)
names(indiv.contrib) <- paste0("p.",source[["source_names"]])
names(indiv.sd) <- paste0("sd.",source[["source_names"]])
indiv.contrib$ID <- Pike2$ID
indiv.sd$ID <- Pike2$ID

contrib.pike <- indiv.contrib%>%
  inner_join(indiv.sd, by = "ID")

Pike.contrib <- Pike2 %>%
  inner_join(contrib.pike, by = "ID")%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            capt_date,
            TL_mm = Length,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            area=area,
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13C,

            p.marine=p.marine,
            sd.marine=sd.marine,
            p.lagoon=p.lagoon,
            sd.lagoon=sd.lagoon,
            p.freshwater=p.freshwater,
            sd.freshwater=sd.freshwater)

Pike.length <- ggplot(Pike.contrib)+

  geom_smooth(aes(TL_mm, p.freshwater, color="freshwater", fill="freshwater"))+

  scale_color_manual(name = "energy source",

                     labels = c("marine food web", "lagoon food web", "freshwater food web"))+
  scale_fill_manual(name = "energy source",
                     breaks = c("marine", "lagoon", "freshwater"),

                     labels = c("marine food web", "lagoon food web", "freshwater food web"))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0),

  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0),

  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1))+
  theme_classic()+
  pl.theme

ggsave("Figures/diet-per-length_global.png", Pike.length, width = 15, height = 9, units = "cm", dpi = 600)

global <- ggplot(global.contrib2)+
```

```{r backcalculation of body length from lens diameter, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

#read in lenses for linear regression
Lens_outer <- fread("Data/Pike/Lens-outer-vs-TL.csv")

#read in main sample
Lens_samples <- fread("Data/Pike/Lens-data-clean-reversed.csv")
Lens_samples$Fish_ID <- Lens_samples$fish_ID

#read in fish data
Pike1 <- fread("C:/Users/timor/Nextcloud2/Boddenhecht/Data/Pike Data/1.pike_data_base_FOR_USERS/1Pike_Latest_Version.txt")

Lensmodel <- lm(diameter_mm~TL_mm, data = Lens_outer)
summary(Lensmodel)

#Predict absolute lens diameter for main sample
Pikeyes <- Pike1%>%
  inner_join(Lens_samples, by = "Fish_ID")%>%
  transmute(fish_ID=Fish_ID,
            capt_date=Date,
            TL_mm=Total_Length_mm,
            gape_mm=Gape,
            weight_g=Weight,
            sex=Sex,
            waterbody=Waterbody,
            Lat=Capture_Latitude,
            Long=Capture_Longitude,
            lens_layer=lens_layer,
            diameter_mm=diameter_mm)

#Calculate missing total diameters
Pikeyes$total.diameter.mm <- predict(Lensmodel, newdata = Pikeyes)

#Perform Fraser-Lee backcalculation
a <- coefficients(Lensmodel)[[1]]
b <- coefficients(Lensmodel)[[2]]

Pikeyes.back <- Pikeyes%>%
  mutate(Length_back = (diameter_mm/total.diameter.mm)*(TL_mm-a)+a)

#Join isotope data
Isolens <- fread("Data/pike/Eye-lens-all_clean.csv")

reverse_layers <- function(layer_vector) {
  max_layer <- max(layer_vector)
  return(max_layer - (layer_vector - min(layer_vector)))
}

Isolens2 <- Isolens%>%
  group_by(ID)%>%
  transmute(fish_ID=ID,
            lens_layer=reverse_layers(Layer),
            amount=amount,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13C,
            d34S=d34S,
            CN_ratio)

Pikeyes.clean <- Pikeyes.back%>%

# join ecotypes

Ecotypes2 <- Ecotypes%>%
  transmute(fish_ID=ID,
            area=waterbody,
            phenotype=phenotype)%>%
  distinct()

Pikeyes.eco <- Pikeyes.clean%>%
  inner_join(Ecotypes2, by = "fish_ID")

#Join muscle data

Pikemuscles_clean <- Pikemuscles%>%
  group_by(ID)%>%
  transmute(fish_ID=ID,
            capt_date=capt_date,

            weight_g=weight_g,
            sex=sex,
            waterbody=waterbody,

            diameter_mm=NA,
            total.diameter.mm=NA,
            Length_back=NA,
            ID=fish_ID,
            amount=NA,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13C,
            d34S=d34S,
            CN_ratio=CN_ratio,
            area=study_area,
            phenotype=ecotype)%>%
  distinct()

Pikeyes_muscles <- rbind(Pikeyes.eco, Pikemuscles_clean)

Pikeyes_muscles2 <- Pikeyes_muscles%>%
```

```{r marry lens data to otoliths, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

#load lens data with length
Lensdata <- fread("Data/Pike/Lens-SI-all-clean-TL-backcalculated.csv")

#load otolith data
Pikeoto <- fread("Data/Pike/Pikedata_model.csv")

Pikeoto <- as.data.frame(Pikeoto)
Pikeoto$ID <- as.factor(Pikeoto$ID)

Pikeoto2 <- Pikeoto%>%
  group_by(ID)%>%
  dplyr::mutate(trad_um = max(rad_um))

#Backcalculate lengths
ggplot(Pikeoto2, aes(x = TL_mm, y = trad_um))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_bw()

otomod <- lm(TL_mm~trad_um, data = Pikeoto2)
summary(otomod)

a <- coefficients(otomod)[[1]]
#Model not needed, as otoliths form at birth!

Pikeoto3 <- Pikeoto2%>%
  dplyr::mutate(length_back = (rad_um/trad_um)*(TL_mm))

ALK <- Pikeoto3%>%
  transmute(fish_ID = ID,
            lifeyear = lifeyear,
            length_back = length_back)%>%
  distinct()

#Marry to eye lens layers
Pikelenses <- as.data.frame(Pikelenses)
ALK <- as.data.frame(ALK)

#Filter out non-Oto fish
IDlist <- unique(ALK$ID)

Pikelenses <- Lensdata%>%
  filter(fish_ID %in% IDlist)%>%
  drop_na(Length_back)


IDOto <- unique(Pikelenses$fish_ID)
age <- NULL
ages <- NULL

for (i in 1:length(IDOto)) {
  age <- ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 1), "length_back"], 1,
                 ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 2), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 1), "length_back"], 2,
                   ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 3), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 2), "length_back"], 3,
                   ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 4), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 3), "length_back"], 4,
                   ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 5), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 4), "length_back"], 5,
                   ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 6), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 5), "length_back"], 6,
                   ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 7), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 6), "length_back"], 7,
                   ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 8), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 7), "length_back"], 8,
                   ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 9), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 8), "length_back"], 9,
                   ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 10), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 9), "length_back"], 10, NA))))))))))
  ages <- na.omit(c(ages, age))
}

Pikelenses$age <- ages

Pikelenses_age <- Pikelenses%>%
  transmute(ID = fish_ID,
            lifeyear = age,
            amount = amount,
            d15N = d15N,
            d13C = d13C,
            d34S = d34S,
            CN_ratio = CN_ratio)%>%
  distinct()

Pike_oto_lenses <- Pikeoto3%>%
  inner_join(Pikelenses_age, by = c("ID", "lifeyear"))

Pikedata_model <- Pike_oto_lenses%>%
  group_by(ID, lifeyear)%>%
  dplyr::reframe(ID = ID,
                   waterbody = waterbody,
                   TL_mm = TL_mm,
                   phenotype = phenotype,
                   sex = sex,
                   lifeyear = lifeyear,
                   res_mean = res_mean,
                   Sr_mean = Sr_mean,
                   genotype = genotype,
                   length_back = length_back,
                   d15N_mean = mean(d15N, na.rm = T),
                   d13C_mean = mean(d13C, na.rm = T),
                   d34S_mean = mean(d34S, na.rm = T),
                   CN_mean = mean(CN_ratio, na.rm = T))%>%
  distinct()

fwrite(Pikedata_model, "Data/Pike/Pikedata-eye-lens-years.csv")
```

```{r GLMMs age-specific growth, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

Data <- fread("Data/Pike/Pikedata-eye-lens-years.csv")

Data2 <- Data%>%
  drop_na(d34S_mean)%>%
  group_by(ID)%>%
  reframe(ID = ID,
          lifeyear = lifeyear,
          waterbody = as.factor(waterbody),
          phenotype = phenotype,
          genotype = genotype,
          sex = sex,
          res_mean = res_mean,
          Sr_mean = Sr_mean,
          length_back = case_when(lifeyear > 1 ~ length_back-lag(length_back),
                                  TRUE ~ length_back),
          d13C = case_when(max(lifeyear) != 1 ~ scale(d13C_mean, center = T, scale = T),
                           TRUE ~ (d13C_mean-(mean(Data$d13C_mean)))),
          d15N = case_when(max(lifeyear) != 1 ~ scale(d15N_mean, center = T, scale = T),
                           TRUE ~ (d15N_mean-(mean(Data$d15N_mean)))),
          d34S = case_when(max(lifeyear) != 1 ~ scale(d34S_mean, center = T, scale = T),
                           TRUE ~ (d34S_mean-(mean(Data$d34S_mean, na.rm = T)))),
          CN = case_when(max(lifeyear) != 1 ~ scale(CN_mean, center = T, scale = T),
                           TRUE ~ (CN_mean-(mean(Data$CN_mean)))))%>%
  drop_na(length_back, d13C, d15N, d34S)%>%
  filter(length_back < 500)

length(unique(Data2$ID))

fwrite(Data2, "Data/Pike/Pikedata-model.csv")

pikemodel1 <- lmer(length_back~lifeyear+sex+d13C+d15N+d34S+CN+(1|ID), data = Data2, REML = T)

pike.vif <- vif(pikemodel1)

barplot(pike.vif, main = "VIF values", horiz = F, col = "darkgreen", ylim = c(0,10),
        las = 2)
abline(h = 5, lwd = 3, lty = 2, col="red")

#test effects
rand(pikemodel1)
#Individual is significant

#Test age effect
pikemodel_noage <- update(pikemodel1, ~. -lifeyear)
anova(pikemodel1, pikemodel_noage)

#Test sex effect
pikemodel_nosex <- update(pikemodel1, ~. -sex)
anova(pikemodel1, pikemodel_nosex)

#Test d13C
pikemodel_no13C <- update(pikemodel1, ~. -d13C)
anova(pikemodel1, pikemodel_no13C)

#Test d15N
pikemodel_no15N <- update(pikemodel1, ~. -d15N)
anova(pikemodel1, pikemodel_no15N)

#test d34S
pikemodel_no34S <- update(pikemodel1, ~. -d34S)
anova(pikemodel1, pikemodel_no34S)

#test CN ratio
pikemodel_nofat <- update(pikemodel1, ~. -CN)
anova(pikemodel1, pikemodel_nofat)

anova(pikemodel1, pikemodel_noage, pikemodel_nosex, pikemodel_no13C, pikemodel_no15N, pikemodel_no34S, pikemodel_nofat)

summary(pikemodel1)
tab_model(pikemodel1)

r.squaredGLMM(pikemodel1)
r.squaredGLMM(pikemodel_nosex)
r.squaredGLMM(pikemodel_no13C)
r.squaredGLMM(pikemodel_no15N)
r.squaredGLMM(pikemodel_no34S)
r.squaredGLMM(pikemodel_nofat)
```

```{r alternative models, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
anova(pikemodel3, pikemodel_no13C)

#Test d15N
pikemodel_no15N <- update(pikemodel3, ~. -lifeyear*d15N)
anova(pikemodel3, pikemodel_no15N)

#test d34S
pikemodel_no34S <- update(pikemodel3, ~. -lifeyear*d34S)
anova(pikemodel3, pikemodel_no34S)

#test CN ratio
pikemodel_nofat <- update(pikemodel3, ~. -CN)

anova(pikemodel3, pikemodel_nosex, pikemodel_no13C, pikemodel_no15N, pikemodel_no34S, pikemodel_nofat)

r.squaredGLMM(pikemodel3)
r.squaredGLMM(pikemodel_nosex)
r.squaredGLMM(pikemodel_no13C)
r.squaredGLMM(pikemodel_no15N)
r.squaredGLMM(pikemodel_no34S)
r.squaredGLMM(pikemodel_nofat)

summary(pikemodel1)
summary(pikemodel2)
summary(pikemodel3)
```

```{r model eval, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
qqline(resid(pikemodel1))
dev.off()

plot(Data3$resid~Data3$lifeyear, ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "Age")

plot(Data3$resid~Data3$d13C, ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "d13C")
```

```{r GLMM model figures, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
pikes <- fread("Data/Pike/Pikedata-model.csv")

pikes <- pikes%>%
  reframe(ID = ID,
          lifeyear = lifeyear,
          waterbody = as.factor(waterbody),
          phenotype = phenotype,
          genotype = genotype,
          sex = sex,
          res_mean = res_mean,

          d15N = d15N,
          d34S = d34S,
          CN = CN)

#factorize age

                         ifelse(pikes$lifeyear==2, 1,
                                ifelse(pikes$lifeyear>2, 3, NA)))

pikes$agefact2 <- factor(pikes$agefact,levels = c(2,1,3),
                                            labels = c("0-1 years", "1-2 years", 
                                                       "> 2 years"))

mypallette <- viridis::viridis(4, direction = -1)

#Isotope effects growth
d34S <- ggplot(pikes, aes(d34S,length_back))+
  geom_point(size=.5)+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2,2))+
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", fill="#440154FF", color = "#FDE725FF", fullrange = T, lwd=.8)+
  labs(x=expression("scaled"~delta^34*"S"~("z-score")), 
       y="yearly growth increment (mm)")+
  scale_color_viridis_d()+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(),
        legend.position = c(.9,.82),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.box.background = element_rect(),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, colour = "black", linetype = 1),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = .5, colour = "black"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(t=15), colour = "black"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(t=15), colour = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
        legend.key.size = unit(.8,"line"))

Isogrowth <- ggarrange(d34S, CN, nrow = 1, labels = c("A", "B"), 
                       hjust = 1, common.legend = T, legend = "bottom")
Isogrowth2 <- annotate_figure(Isogrowth, left = text_grob("Annual growth (mm)", rot = 90))

ggsave("Figures/Iso-effect-growth.png", d34S, width = 15, height = 9, units = "cm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```

```{r compare models}
rm(list = ls())

base <- readRDS("Data/pike/fit_gamma_diet_base.rds")
CNS_CN <- readRDS("Data/pike/fit_gamma_diet_CNS_CN.rds")
CNS <- readRDS("Data/pike/fit_gamma_diet_CNS.rds")
CN <- readRDS("Data/pike/fit_gamma_diet_CS.rds")
NS <- readRDS("Data/pike/fit_gamma_diet_NS.rds")
CN <- readRDS("Data/pike/fit_gamma_diet_CN.rds")

fits = list(base = fit_base, CNS_CN = fit_CNS_CN, CNS = fit_CNS, CN = fit_CN, CS = fit_CS, NS = fit_NS)

loos = lapply(fits, loo, pars = "log_lik")

looics = sapply(loos, function(x) x$estimates['looic', 'Estimate'])
delta_looic = looics - min(looics)
wi = exp(-0.5*delta_looic) / sum(exp(-0.5*delta_looic))
round(rbind(looic = looics, dlooic = delta_looic, weight = wi), 2)
```

```{r age length key from pike scales and otoliths, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

#Remove BH-90239, BH-90324, BH-90105, BH-90019, BH-90112

Pikescales <- fread("Data/Pike/Transmitter-pike-ages-with-TL.csv")

Pikescales <- Pikescales%>%filter(!fish_ID %in% c("BH-90239", "BH-90324", "BH-90105", "BH-90019", "BH-90112", "BH-90037"))

lm.scale <- lm(TL_mm~total_rad, data = Pikescales)

summary(lm.scale)

ggplot(Pikescales, aes(x = TL_mm, y = total_rad))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_bw()

a <- coefficients(lm.scale)[[1]]
b <- coefficients(lm.scale)[[2]]

Pikescales <- Pikescales%>%
  mutate(length_back = (rad/total_rad)*(TL_mm-a)+a)

Pikeages <- Pikescales%>%
  transmute(length = length_back/10,
            sex=sex,
            age = lifeyear)%>%
  mutate(lcat5 = lencat(length, w = 5))%>%
  distinct()

#length frequency table
alk.freq <- xtabs(~lcat5+age, data = Pikeages)
rowSums(alk.freq)

#probability table of age at length
alk <- prop.table(alk.freq, margin = 1)
round(alk, 3)

#run multinominal log-linear models, increase iterations to converge
agemodel1 <- multinom(age ~ lcat5, data = Pikeages, maxit = 1000)
agemodel2 <- multinom(age ~ lcat5*sex, data = Pikeages, maxit = 1000)

anova(agemodel1, agemodel2)
#who would´ve thought, sex is highly significant...

length_sim <- seq(min(Pikeages$lcat5), max(Pikeages$lcat5), 5)
dfF <- data.frame(lcat5 = length_sim, sex = "f")
dfM <- data.frame(lcat5 = length_sim, sex = "m")

alkF <- predict(agemodel2, dfF, type = "probs")
rownames(alkF) <- length_sim
alkPlot(alkF, type = "area", pal = "grey", xlab = "total lengt (cm)", showLegend = TRUE, leg.cex = 0.7)
alkPlot(alkF,type="bubble",xlab="Total Length (mm)")

alkM <- predict(agemodel2, dfM, type = "probs")
rownames(alkM) <- length_sim
alkPlot(alkM, type = "area", pal = "grey", xlab = "total lengt (cm)", showLegend = TRUE, leg.cex = 0.7)
alkPlot(alkM,type="bubble",xlab="Total Length (mm)")

#Need to split girls from boys

Lenspike <- fread("Data/Pike/Lens-SI-all-clean-TL-backcalculated.csv")

LenspikeF <- Lenspike%>%
  filter(sex == "f" & Length_back >= 150)%>%
  transmute(fish_ID=fish_ID,
            sex=sex,
            lens_layer=lens_layer,
            Length_back=Length_back/10,
            lcat5 = lencat(Length_back, w = 5))%>%
  distinct()

LenspikeM <- Lenspike%>%
  filter(sex == "m" & Length_back >= 150)%>%
  transmute(fish_ID=fish_ID,
            sex=sex,
            lens_layer=lens_layer,
            Length_back=Length_back/10,
            lcat5 = lencat(Length_back, w = 5))%>%
  distinct()



#Split male and female
PikeagesF <- Pikeages%>%filter(sex == "f")
PikeagesM <- Pikeages%>%filter(sex == "m")

#Age-length frequency

alk_freqM <- xtabs(~lcat5+age, data = PikeagesM)

alkF <- prop.table(alk_freqF, margin = 1)
alkM <- prop.table(alk_freqM, margin = 1)

length_nF <- xtabs(~lcat5, data = PikeagesF)
length_nM <- xtabs(~lcat5, data = PikeagesM)

alkAgeDist(alkF, lenA.n = rowSums(alk_freqF), len.n = length_nF)
alkAgeDist(alkM, lenA.n = rowSums(alk_freqM), len.n = length_nM)

alkMeanVar(alkF, length~lcat5+age, data = PikeagesF, len.n = length_nF)
alkMeanVar(alkM, length~lcat5+age, data = PikeagesM, len.n = length_nM)

LenspikeF$age <- NA
LenspikeF$age <- as.numeric(LenspikeF$age)

LenspikeM$age <- NA

LenspikeF <- LenspikeF%>%drop_na(Length_back)
LenspikeM <- LenspikeM%>%drop_na(Length_back)

AgedeyeM <- alkIndivAge(alkM, age~Length_back, data = LenspikeM)

#Join together
```

```{r cleanup scale data, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
            year=year,
            inc_mm=inc_mm,
            quality=quality)%>%
  distinct()

#LOOK AT IT!!!!
ggplot(All.scale.pike[All.scale.pike$quality==3,], aes(as.factor(age), TL_mm))+
  geom_point(aes(color = sex))+
  geom_smooth()+
  theme_bw()

#Form mean age and select
pike_ages <- All.scale.pike%>%
  group_by(fish_ID)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(fish_ID=fish_ID,
            age=median(age, na.rm = T))%>%
  distinct()

pikeages_final <- All.scale.pike%>%
  inner_join(pike_ages, by = c("fish_ID", "age"))%>%
  group_by(fish_ID, lifeyear)%>%
  filter(lifeyear!="Piscivorous")%>%
  transmute(fish_ID=fish_ID,
                   date=date,
                   waterbody=waterbody,
                   TL_mm=TL_mm,
                   weight_g=weight_g,
                   sex=sex,
                   age=case_when(month(date)<5 & month(date)>=1~age+1,
                                 TRUE~age),
                   cohort=cohort,
                   pisc=mean(pisc, na.rm=T),
                   lifeyear=case_when(lifeyear=="edge" & month(date)<5 & month(date)>=1~"edgeyear",
                                      TRUE~lifeyear),
                   year=year,
                   inc_mm=mean(inc_mm, na.rm=T))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  distinct()

pikeages_final <- as.data.frame(pikeages_final)

IDpike <- unique(pikeages_final$fish_ID)
rad <- NULL
for (i in 1:length(IDpike)) {
  d <- cumsum(coalesce(pikeages_final[which(pikeages_final$fish_ID == IDpike[i]), "inc_mm"], 0)) +
    pikeages_final[which(pikeages_final$fish_ID == IDpike[i]), "inc_mm"]*0
  
  rad <- c(rad, d)
}

pikeages_final$rad <- rad

pikeages_final2 <- pikeages_final%>%
  filter(lifeyear!="edge")%>%
  mutate(yearcont=case_when(lifeyear=="edgeyear"~age,
                            TRUE~as.numeric(lifeyear)))%>%
  group_by(fish_ID)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(fish_ID=fish_ID,
            date=date,
            waterbody=waterbody,
            TL_mm=TL_mm,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            sex=sex,
            age=age,
            cohort=cohort,
            pisc=pisc,
            lifeyear=yearcont,
            year=year,
            inc_mm=inc_mm,
            rad=rad,
            total_rad=max(rad))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  distinct()

fwrite(pikeages_final2, "Data/Pike/Transmitter-pike-ages-with-TL.csv")
```

```{r combine scale data with isotopes, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

Pike <- fread("Data/Pike/Pike_SI_all_clean_average_lipid-corrected.csv")
Pikescales <- fread("Data/Pike/Transmitter-pike-ages-with-TL.csv")

#Check for which fish both data are there
Pike2 <- Pike%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            area=area,
            SI="Yes")%>%
  distinct()

Pikescales2 <- Pikescales%>%
  transmute(ID=fish_ID,
            waterbody=waterbody,
            Scaleage="Yes")

Pikecheck <- Pikescales2%>%
  left_join(Pike2, by = "ID")%>%
  distinct()

length(Pikecheck[Pikecheck$SI=="Yes"]$ID)

#Prepare join
Pike.SI <- Pike%>%
  transmute(fish_ID=ID,
            species=Species,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13C,
            d34S=d34S,
            CN_ratio=CN_ratio)

#Backcalculate length
ggplot(Pikescales, aes(total_rad, TL_mm))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")+
  theme_minimal()

lm.scale <- lm(TL_mm~total_rad, data = Pikescales)

summary(lm.scale)

a <- coefficients(lm.scale)[[1]]
b <- coefficients(lm.scale)[[2]]

Pikescales <- Pikescales%>%
  mutate(length_back = (rad/total_rad)*(TL_mm-a)+a)

#Prepare age-corrected growth index
Pikescales[, length_age_plus_1 := shift(length_back, type = "lead"), by = fish_ID]

#linear regression of inc+1 with inc
length.mod <- lm(length_age_plus_1~length_back, data = Pikescales)
summary(length.mod)

length_slope <- coefficients(length.mod)[[2]]
#Predict increment for each year
Pikescales2 <- Pikescales%>%
  mutate(length_predict=length_back*length_slope)

Pikescales2[, length_predict := shift(length_back, type = "lag"), by = fish_ID]

ggplot(Pikescales, aes(length_back, length_age_plus_1))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")+
  theme_minimal()

Pikescales.final <- Pikescales2%>%
  transmute(fish_ID=fish_ID,
            date=date,
            waterbody=waterbody,
            TL_mm=TL_mm,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            sex=sex,
            age=as.factor(age),
            pisc=pisc,
            lifeyear=lifeyear,
            inc_mm,
            growth_index=length_back-length_predict)%>%
  group_by(fish_ID)%>%
  filter(lifeyear==last(lifeyear))

#join with isotopes
Pike.scales.SI <- Pikescales.final%>%
  inner_join(Pike.SI, by = "fish_ID")

pl_theme <- theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
                  axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
                  legend.key.size = unit(.5, "cm"),
                  legend.text = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
                  legend.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"))

C <- ggplot(Pike.scales.SI, aes(age, growth_index, color = d13C))+
  geom_point(size=.5)+
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Age-corrected growth")+
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(1, 13, 2))+
  scale_color_viridis_c()+
  theme_minimal()+
  pl_theme

N <- ggplot(Pike.scales.SI, aes(age, growth_index, color = d15N))+
  geom_point(size=.5)+
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Age-corrected growth")+
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(1, 13, 2))+
  scale_color_viridis_c()+
  theme_minimal()+
  pl_theme


S <- ggplot(Pike.scales.SI, aes(age, growth_index, color = d34S))+
  geom_point(size=.5)+
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Age-corrected growth")+
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(1, 13, 2))+
  scale_color_viridis_c()+
  theme_minimal()+
  pl_theme


CNS <- ggarrange(C, N, S, nrow = 1)

ggsave("Figures/CNS-plot-growth-index.png", CNS, width = 15, height = 5, units = "cm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
fwrite(Pike.scales.SI, "Data/Pike/Pike-data-SI-growth.csv")
```

```{r modelling growth, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

Pike.scales.SI <- fread("Data/Pike/Pike-data-SI-growth.csv")

Pike.scales.Si2 <- Pike.scales.SI%>%
  transmute(fish_ID=fish_ID,
            waterbody=waterbody,
            sex=sex,
            age=age,
            pisc_scale=scale(pisc),
            lifeyear=lifeyear,
            growth_index=growth_index,
            d15N_scale=scale(d15N),
            d13C_scale=scale(d13C),
            d34S_scale=scale(d34S),
            CN_scale=scale(CN_ratio))%>%
  drop_na(growth_index)

Pikemodel.1 <- lmer(growth_index~sex+age+pisc_scale+d15N_scale+d13C_scale+d34S_scale+CN_scale+d15N_scale*d13C_scale*d34S_scale+(1|waterbody), REML = T, data = Pike.scales.Si2)

summary(Pikemodel.1)

#Look at variance inflation factors
pike.vif <- vif(Pikemodel.1)

barplot(pike.vif[,3], main = "VIF values", horiz = F, col = "darkgreen", ylim = c(0,6),
        las = 2)
abline(h = 5, lwd = 3, lty = 2, col="red")

#test effects
rand(Pikemodel.1)

#test threeway interaction
Pikemodel.nointer <- update(Pikemodel.1, ~.-d15N_scale*d13C_scale*d34S_scale)

anova(Pikemodel.1, Pikemodel.nointer)

#remove threeway
Pikemodel.1.1 <- lmer(growth_index~sex+age+pisc_scale+age*d15N_scale+age*d13C_scale+age*d34S_scale+CN_scale+(1|waterbody), 
                      REML = T, data = Pike.scales.Si2)

#test sex
Pikemodel.nosex <- update(Pikemodel.1.1, ~.-sex)

anova(Pikemodel.1.1, Pikemodel.nosex)
#sex is significant

#test age
Pikemodel.noage <- update(Pikemodel.1.1, ~.-age)

anova(Pikemodel.1.1, Pikemodel.noage)
#age is significant

#test piscivory
Pikemodel.nopisc <- update(Pikemodel.1.1, ~.-pisc_scale)

anova(Pikemodel.1.1, Pikemodel.nopisc)
#Piscivory is not significant

#test d15N
Pikemodel.noN <- update(Pikemodel.1.1, ~.-age*d15N_scale)

anova(Pikemodel.1.1, Pikemodel.noN)
#d15N is not significant

#test d13C
Pikemodel.noC <- update(Pikemodel.1.1, ~.-age*d13C_scale)

anova(Pikemodel.1.1, Pikemodel.noC)
#d13C is significant

#Test d34S
Pikemodel.noS <- update(Pikemodel.1.1, ~.-age*d34S_scale)

anova(Pikemodel.1.1, Pikemodel.noS)
#d34S is significant

#test CN_ratio
Pikemodel.nofat <- update(Pikemodel.1.1, ~.-CN_scale)

anova(Pikemodel.1.1, Pikemodel.nofat)
#CN-ratio not significant
```

```{r model summary, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
Pikemodel.final <- lmer(growth_index~sex+age+age*d15N_scale+age*d13C_scale+age*d34S_scale+CN_scale+(1|waterbody), 
                      REML = T, data = Pike.scales.Si2)

summary(Pikemodel.final)
r.squaredGLMM(Pikemodel.final)
tab_model(Pikemodel.final)

plot(Pike.scales.Si2$age, Pike.scales.Si2$growth_index)
```

```{r model eval, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
Pike.scales.Si2$resid <- resid(Pikemodel.final)

plot(Pikemodel.final, xlab = "Fitted", ylab = "Residuals")

hist(Pike.scales.Si2$resid, main = "", xlab = "Residuals")

qqnorm(resid(Pikemodel.final))
qqline(resid(Pikemodel.final))

par(mfrow=c(2,3))
plot(Pike.scales.Si2$resid~as.factor(Pike.scales.Si2$sex), ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "Sex")
plot(Pike.scales.Si2$resid~Pike.scales.Si2$age, ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "Age")
plot(Pike.scales.Si2$resid~Pike.scales.Si2$d15N_scale, ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "d15N")
plot(Pike.scales.Si2$resid~Pike.scales.Si2$d13C_scale, ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "d13C")
plot(Pike.scales.Si2$resid~Pike.scales.Si2$d34S_scale, ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "d34S")
plot(Pike.scales.Si2$resid~Pike.scales.Si2$CN_scale, ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "C:N ratio")
```

```{r predict growth, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

Pike.scales.SI <- fread("Data/Pike/Pike-data-SI-growth.csv")

Pike.scales.Si2 <- Pike.scales.SI%>%
  transmute(fish_ID=fish_ID,
            waterbody=waterbody,
            sex=sex,
            age=age,
            pisc_scale=scale(pisc),
            lifeyear=lifeyear,
            growth_index=growth_index,
            d15N_scale=scale(d15N),
            d13C_scale=scale(d13C),
            d34S_scale=scale(d34S),
            CN_scale=scale(CN_ratio))%>%
  drop_na(growth_index)

Pikemodel.final <- lmer(growth_index~sex+age+age*d15N_scale+age*d13C_scale+age*d34S_scale+CN_scale+(1|waterbody), 
                      REML = T, data = Pike.scales.Si2)

sex <- unique(Pike.scales.Si2$sex)
age <- unique(Pike.scales.Si2$age)
waterbody <- unique(Pike.scales.Si2$waterbody)
d15N <- seq(min(Pike.scales.Si2$d15N_scale), max(Pike.scales.Si2$d15N_scale), 3.4)
d13C <- seq(min(Pike.scales.Si2$d13C_scale), max(Pike.scales.Si2$d13C_scale), 1)
d34S <- seq(min(Pike.scales.Si2$d34S_scale), max(Pike.scales.Si2$d34S_scale), 1)
CN_ratio <- mean(Pike.scales.Si2$CN_scale)

Newdata <- expand.grid(sex=sex,
                       age=age,
                       d15N_scale=d15N,
                       d13C_scale=d13C,
                       d34S_scale=d34S,
                       CN_scale=CN_ratio,
                       waterbody=waterbody)

head(Newdata)

Newdata$prediction <- predict(Pikemodel.final, newdata = Newdata, allow.new.levels = TRUE, type = "response")

pl_theme <- theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
                  axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
                  legend.key.size = unit(.5, "cm"),
                  legend.text = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
                  legend.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"))

C <- ggplot(Newdata, aes(d13C_scale, prediction))+
  geom_point(size = .2)+
  labs(x = "scaled d13C", y = "predicted growth index")+
  theme_bw()+
  pl_theme

N <- ggplot(Newdata, aes(d15N_scale, prediction))+
  geom_point(size = .2)+
  labs(x = "scaled d15N", y = "predicted growth index")+
  theme_bw()+
  pl_theme

S <- ggplot(Newdata, aes(d34S_scale, prediction))+
  geom_point(size = .2)+
  labs(x = "scaled d34S", y = "predicted growth index")+
  theme_bw()+
  pl_theme

ggplot(Newdata, aes(as.factor(waterbody), prediction))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  labs(x = "Age", y = "predicted growth index")+
  theme_bw()

CNS <- ggarrange(C, N, S, nrow = 1)

ggsave("Figures/CNS-plot-predicted.png", CNS, width = 15, height = 5, units = "cm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```
